cohort: The study included 1,030 Chinese women from late pregnancy (28 and 37 gestational weeks) to 6 months after delivery.
finding: The study identified two distinct patterns of perinatal fatigue among women: 'persistently high' (11.1%) and 'persistently low' (88.9%), with complications, initial fatigue, and employment status being significant predictors, and the 'persistently high' group experiencing more difficult baby care and weight retention, and lower exclusive breastfeeding rates.
gest_age: From 28 gestational weeks to 37 gestational weeks at baseline measurements
